text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Project Overview Document states Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown states the budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 following the Finance Committee's December 2026 revision."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Both input values ($2,400,000 and $2,600,000) appear in the cited evidence and the difference of $200,000 is correct."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Team & Governance Document states that budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation."},{"claim_index":4,"verdict":"PARTIAL","reason":"The document says the revision was made by the Finance Committee, but it does not state that this was the required pre-implementation approval, so the conclusion that the required body was involved goes beyond the quoted evidence."},{"claim_index":5,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"A neutral label asserting no fact."}]}
